new: Residential zones created after July 7, 2026 need a human-reviewed KYC approval, open only to registered companies that verify a corporate email domain, started only after real funds are added, and submitted with a company registration document; ISP and Datacenter proxies and the Web Unlocker API need no KYC. Approved residential traffic is scoped to the KYC use case: requests to domains or categories outside it return an Access denied error. Government websites are blocked on every network. There is no no-KYC residential path for a zone created after July 7, 2026: an Add-a-Zone request from an account that has not completed KYC is blocked with HTTP 403 and the compliance error kyc_required or business_account_required. The immediate (no-KYC) residential access mode, with its 402 bad_endpoint errors, applies only to zones created on or before July 7, 2026, and immediate access to the Residential network is no longer supported effective 2026-10-19. The trust-center KYC FAQ still offers immediate residential proxy access without KYC and links to an immediate-access section that the Residential network access policy no longer has; that FAQ page was last modified on 2025-09-08.
